flows.name: seam-01 真实后端载荷：前端收得下、渲染得出（指标卡、表格、图表、单位、能力标记）

steps.assertText: 接入真实数据后会自动替换

steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('METRIC_CARD', '元'); if (!r) return false; const t = window.__seamText(r.regionId); return t.includes(window.__seamExpected(r)) && t.includes('元'); })()
(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('METRIC_CARD', ''); if (!r) return false; const t = window.__seamText(r.regionId); return t.includes(window.__seamExpected(r)) && !t.includes('kWh'); })()
(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('METRIC_CARD', '元'); if (!r) return false; return !window.__seamText(r.regionId).includes('kWh'); })()

(() => { const notes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-capability]')).map(n => n.textContent).join(' | '); if (!notes) return false; const pending = (window.__seamFixture.payload.regions || []).flatMap(r => (r.payload.metrics || []).filter(m => m.capabilityPending === true)); if (!pending.length) return false; return pending.every(m => notes.includes(m.label) && notes.includes(m.pendingReason)); })()

(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('CHART'); if (!r) return false; const t = window.__seamText(r.regionId); return t.includes('单位：' + r.payload.unit) && t.includes(r.payload.yValues.length + ' 个数据点') && t.includes(r.payload.xLabels[0]); })()

(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('TABLE'); if (!r) return false; const card = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="' + r.regionId + '"]'); const table = card.querySelector('table'); if (!table) return false; const offset = r.payload.rowNumber ? 1 : 0; const head = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('thead th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()); const colsOk = r.payload.columns.every((c, i) => (head[i + offset] || '').includes(c.label)); const trs = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr'); const cells = trs[0] ? trs[0].querySelectorAll('td') : []; const first = r.payload.rows[0]; const cellOk = r.payload.columns.every((c, i) => (cells[i + offset] || {}).textContent === String(first[c.fieldRef])); return colsOk && cellOk && trs.length === r.payload.rows.length; })()

(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('TABLE'); if (!r) return false; const card = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="' + r.regionId + '"]'); const cells = card.querySelectorAll('tbody tr td'); return cells.length === r.payload.rows.length * r.payload.columns.length + (r.payload.rowNumber ? r.payload.rows.length : 0); })()

flows.name: seam-02 重新读取会话：重新生成的载荷数字与确认那轮完全一致

steps.eval: (() => { const f = window.__seamFixture; const norm = p => (p.regions || []).map(r => r.regionId + ':' + JSON.stringify(r.payload)).join('|'); return norm(f.payload) === norm(f.stageRestorePayload); })()
(() => { const f = window.__seamFixture; const a = f.payload.previewContext; const b = f.stageRestorePayload.previewContext; return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b); })()

(() => { const f = window.__seamFixture; return f.payload.regions.every(r => { const t = window.__seamText(r.regionId); if (!t) return false; if (r.componentType === 'METRIC_CARD') return t.includes(window.__seamExpected(r)); return true; }); })()

(() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('CHART'); if (!r) return false; const t = window.__seamText(r.regionId); return t.includes('单位：' + r.payload.unit) && t.includes(r.payload.yValues.length + ' 个数据点'); })()

flows.name: seam-03 接缝断掉时：载荷被丢弃、页面回到空态（harness 能验出回归）

steps.assertText: 草稿已保存，示意数据还没生成

steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__seamRegion('METRIC_CARD'); if (!r) return false; return !document.querySelector('#preview-root').textContent.includes(window.__seamExpected(r)); })()
